summary: This Form 6-K reports positive interim clinical trial data from Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals' Phase 1b/2a RESOLVE trial for EP-104GI in eosinophilic esophagitis. The press release announces 36-week tissue health and symptom results for the highest dose cohort (Cohort 9, n=3), showing robust response and maintained symptom remission in 66% of patients. No drug-related serious adverse events were observed. This is a routine business update on study progress, not a special situation. The filing does not involve any corporate transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital structure event. It is a standard foreign private issuer report of operational milestones under Rule 13a-16.
